name: Astah Professional
description: A mature commercial UML modeling tool, formerly named JUDE, with a plugin ecosystem and recent improvements to AI assistance, sequence diagrams, search, and collaboration.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 日本老牌UML建模工具，曾用名：JUDE。支持自行编写的插件。新版本支持AI建模。近年来持续加入 AI 辅助建模功能，12.0版进一步改进了序列图编辑、模型检索和团队协作能力。
